title: Dragon and Chameleon
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Garyo Hanagami is a best-selling, acclaimed manga artist; Shinobu Miyama is his bitter assistant with a knack for copying others' styles. An accident swaps their bodies, and Miyama happily takes Hanagami's place, forcing the veteran to rebuild his career from nothing in a rivalry over what makes real art.
life_message: It holds up wholehearted devotion to one's craft as the source of real creative worth.
